title: TextArea
description: Fiori multi-line text field with rows, growing, character counter and value states.

usage.summary: Enter editable prose across multiple lines.
useWhen: Let users write comments, descriptions or other text that needs multiple lines.
Keep a visible label and enough visible rows to understand the text being edited.
Use growing and growingMaxRows for expansion, or maxLength with counterMode when a character limit matters.

avoidWhen.when: Enter a value that fits on one line.
Read prose that is already fully visible and cannot be edited.
Read prose with an in-place option to reveal more text.
